announcements.title: Storm Over South Pier
announcements.body: The next session opens at dusk with the harbor under lightning and a quarantine bell ringing from Dock Nine.

announcements.title: Letter from the Harbormaster
announcements.body:
## To the Blackglass Company

If you mean to keep your rooms at the Gull and Lantern, report to the signal tower before midnight.

- Bring any salvage taken from Dock Nine
- Speak to no one wearing a tar-black ribbon
- If the bells ring twice, leave the pier immediately

announcements.title: Private Ledger Scrap
announcements.body: A damp scrap of ledger paper lists three payments under the initials `E.V.` and marks one warehouse with the symbol of a broken bell.

announcements.title: The Bell Beneath Blackglass
announcements.body: Old sailors swear there is a bell chained below the harbor floor. When it rings, doors open in places the city was supposed to forget.

announcements.title: Seal the Smuggler Tunnel
announcements.body:
Find the flooded tunnel under Saltwake Row before the smugglers use it to move the relic crate.

- Speak with the oyster divers
- Follow the tar-black lantern marks
- Decide whether to collapse or claim the route

announcements.title: Find the Lantern Cartographer
announcements.body: Track down the cartographer who maps impossible alleys during red tide nights. Her charts may reveal where the drowned chapel drifts ashore.

announcements.body: A small lore entry for routing verification.

notes.title: Mira's Research Notes
notes.body: Shared: the sigil on the quarantine bell matches the one in the drowned chapel sketch from the archives.

notes.title: Ballad Fragments
notes.body: Shared: Elira recognizes the melody from the tavern pianist as part of a funeral song for ships lost beyond the fog line.

notes.title: What The Harbor Knows
notes.body: DM note: every faction in Blackglass is pretending not to hear the second bell.

wiki_pages.title: The Bell Beneath Blackglass
wiki_pages.content:
# The Bell Beneath Blackglass

The bell is said to hang in a stone chamber below the harbor floor. It only rings when the tide rises against the old foundations beneath South Pier.

Rumors claim:
- smugglers use the sound as a signal
- drowned spirits answer the second ring
- the city archives sealed every map leading down to it

wiki_pages.title: Seal the Smuggler Tunnel
wiki_pages.content:
Find the flooded tunnel under Saltwake Row before the smugglers use it to move the relic crate.

- Speak with the oyster divers
- Follow the tar-black lantern marks
- Decide whether to collapse or claim the route

wiki_pages.content: Track down the cartographer who maps impossible alleys during red tide nights. Her charts may reveal where the drowned chapel drifts ashore.

wiki_pages.title: The Divine Pantheon of Aetheria
wiki_pages.content:
# The Divine Pantheon of Aetheria

The divine pantheon of Aetheria.

## Members
- Aegis, The Shieldbearer: Guardian deity of protection, resolve, and those who stand between danger and the vulnerable.
- Aquila, The Winged Watcher: Patron of high winds, distant sight, vigilance, and messages carried across the sky.
- Aurora, The Radiant Muse: Beacon of inspiration, beauty, performance, and dawn-lit revelation.
- Chronos, The Time Keeper: Warden of cycles, memory, inevitability, and the long turning of ages.
- Ignatius, The Flamebearer: Divine spark of fire, passion, craft, war-fervor, and consuming transformation.
- Lunara, The Lunar Sentinel: Watcher of moonlight, still waters, dreams, omens, and quiet warding.
- Nimbus, The Mistweaver: Shaper of fog, liminal paths, hidden things, and veils between certainty and myth.
- Ororo, Mistress of Storms: Sovereign of thunder, rainfall, sea-tempests, and the wrathful sky.
- Stellaris, The Celestial Guardian: Keeper of stars, navigation, cosmic order, and oaths sworn beneath the heavens.
- Sylvana, The Shadow Weaver: Mistress of secrecy, twilight, subtle power, and truths best spoken in darkness.
- Terra, The Earthshaper: Patron of stone, harvest, endurance, fertile lands, and mountains that remember.
- Thanatos, The Shepherd of Finality: Guide of endings, death, graves, and the last threshold every soul must cross.

## Notes
This entry was imported from the visible Kanka pantheon listing provided during prototyping.

wiki_pages.content:
# Aetheria, Realm of the Maelstrom

## Setting Overview
In the realm of Aetheria, where the skies are adorned with majestic floating islands and the very fabric of magic weaves through the air, lies the heart of all enchantment: the Tempest Core. Aetheria is a world unlike any other, where gravity is but a suggestion and adventure awaits those who dare to explore its endless skies.

## Core Concepts
- Floating islands dominate the horizon and define travel, territory, and wonder.
- Magic is ambient and woven into the air itself rather than hidden at the edges of the setting.
- The Tempest Core stands as the central force of enchantment and likely a defining source of mystery, power, and conflict.
- Gravity is unstable or mutable, suggesting an aerial, arcane, and mythic world structure.

## Campaign Use
Use this entry as the top-level setting page for the world of Aetheria and as the main reference point for connected regions, factions, gods, races, and major events.

## Canon Note
Imported from the visible Kanka setting entry during prototyping.

world_collections.body:
# The Divine Pantheon of Aetheria

The divine pantheon of Aetheria.

## Members
- Aegis, The Shieldbearer: Guardian deity of protection, resolve, and those who stand between danger and the vulnerable.
- Aquila, The Winged Watcher: Patron of high winds, distant sight, vigilance, and messages carried across the sky.
- Aurora, The Radiant Muse: Beacon of inspiration, beauty, performance, and dawn-lit revelation.
- Chronos, The Time Keeper: Warden of cycles, memory, inevitability, and the long turning of ages.
- Ignatius, The Flamebearer: Divine spark of fire, passion, craft, war-fervor, and consuming transformation.
- Lunara, The Lunar Sentinel: Watcher of moonlight, still waters, dreams, omens, and quiet warding.
- Nimbus, The Mistweaver: Shaper of fog, liminal paths, hidden things, and veils between certainty and myth.
- Ororo, Mistress of Storms: Sovereign of thunder, rainfall, sea-tempests, and the wrathful sky.
- Stellaris, The Celestial Guardian: Keeper of stars, navigation, cosmic order, and oaths sworn beneath the heavens.
- Sylvana, The Shadow Weaver: Mistress of secrecy, twilight, subtle power, and truths best spoken in darkness.
- Terra, The Earthshaper: Patron of stone, harvest, endurance, fertile lands, and mountains that remember.
- Thanatos, The Shepherd of Finality: Guide of endings, death, graves, and the last threshold every soul must cross.

## Notes
This entry was imported from the visible Kanka pantheon listing provided during prototyping.
